en.summary: CONTROL Resonant is Remedy Entertainment's sequel to 2019's Control, releasing September 24, 2026. It swaps protagonists and genres: instead of Jesse Faden's gunplay-focused adventure through the claustrophobic Oldest House, players now control her brother Dylan Faden in a fast-paced action-RPG set across an open-ended, warped reimagining of Manhattan, wielding a shapeshifting melee weapon called the Aberrant.

guideSections.title: Dylan Faden & the Aberrant
guideSections.description: Dylan fights primarily with melee combat and supernatural abilities rather than Jesse's guns, centered on the Aberrant — a shapeshifting weapon — and traversal through Gravity Anomalies, zones where normal physics no longer apply.

guideSections.title: New Game Plus
guideSections.description: Remedy has confirmed New Game Plus carries over Aberrant upgrades, health and resource improvements, unlocked combat abilities, talents, and artifacts — though traversal abilities stay tied to story progression and do not carry over, since a fresh playthrough is built around re-discovering how the world behaves.
